results.note: Amazon US, query 'christmas money holder', page OK (HTTP 200). The query format returned only 3 results, so I retried once in markdown (2 calls in total) and read 48 organic results (sr_1_1 to sr_1_48). None of them is the exact product, the Christmas ball you pull a garland of banknotes out of. The page is dominated by money-holder envelopes and cards and by acrylic, wooden or candy-cane ornaments that hold cash. The closest result is a candy-cane ornament (sr_1_2, B0HD5ZMGZ4), recorded as an adjacent proxy with status ESTIMATION. Other acrylic money-holder ornaments with a badge: B0HFNH12GR '500+ bought in past month' (4 ratings) and B0HGRFW7LW '200+ bought in past month' (7 ratings). No Prime deal badge on the first results. US D signal: high demand for the category, few ratings per listing (new listings in Q4).
